english:
Dealing damage with a Glaive <void Suppresses /> Combatants for 10 seconds.

Glaive Melee <void Suppresses /> enemies at the cost of 10% Glaive Energy, which is not drained if the enemy is already suppressed.

source.text:
Upon dealing a Glaive Damage Instance against Combatants:
Inflicts Suppression for 10 seconds.

Glaive Melee inflicts Suppression at the cost of 10% Glaive Energy.
Does not drain Glaive Energy if the enemy is suppressed.
